about: Pass thresholds for the dish suggestion and substitution evaluation. Declared before any run; the evaluation set is cases.json. A threshold is met when the measured value satisfies the comparison.
frozen: 2026-11-16, in the same commit as cases.json and before the rules baseline or any model run

schema_valid.rationale: Every answer must have the fields the app reads (source, dishes with id, name, category, have, missing, reason, keywords, videos, search_url); a malformed answer breaks the screen.

ids_in_catalog.rationale: The model may only choose dishes from the closed list; an unknown dish id means the list guard failed.

have_missing_consistent.rationale: have and missing come from the dish's key ingredients and the user's items; they must never overlap or name ingredients the dish does not need, because the app shows them as facts.

acceptable_in_top5.rationale: For most inputs at least one of the five shown dishes should be one a home cook could make with at most one missing key ingredient (inputs with nothing to cook must give an empty list).

share_le2_missing.rationale: Most shown dishes should be near-complete (at most two missing key ingredients), otherwise the list is not useful for someone who cooks with what they have.

must_not_include_hits.rationale: Dishes that need three or more missing key ingredients and share items with the input (listed per case) must not appear when many better dishes exist.

invalid_inputs_rejected.rationale: Empty lists, out-of-range limits and oversized lists must be refused (HTTP 422) before any model call.

fallback_valid.rationale: When the model is unavailable the answer must still be valid and marked 'rules' (checked on a fake failing model for every valid case).

pairs_in_table.rationale: Every substitution shown must be a pair the server's substitution table allows with what the user owns; the model only words it.

no_quantities_or_steps.rationale: Suggestions and notes must not invent amounts or cooking steps (digits, units, step words; see README).

empty_with_note_ok.rationale: When no table option exists the answer must be an empty list with the honest note, not an invented substitute.

outcome_match.rationale: The overall outcome (substitutions, optional skips or empty) must match the labelled class for at least 90% of the valid adapt cases.

unknown_rejected.rationale: An unknown dish or an empty ingredient list must be refused (HTTP 422).

latency_median_s.rationale: A model-backed answer should arrive within 5 seconds at the median; checked only in live runs.

reported_not_thresholds: cost per request (USD at 0.10 / 0.40 per million input / output tokens)
rules-only baseline next to the model result
source share (llm vs rules) in suggest answers
